overview: This House resolution assigns four Representatives (Mr. Rutherford, Mr. Garbarino, Mrs. Hinson, and Mr. Moran) to the House Committee on Ethics, the panel that investigates possible misconduct by House members and staff and enforces the chamber's conduct rules. Resolutions like this are the routine way each party's picks for committee seats are formally approved by the full House. It does not change any law or policy. The House agreed to it on March 11, 2025.
for: Supporters say filling Ethics Committee seats lets the House's internal watchdog panel get organized and begin its work for the new Congress.
against: Critics say this is a routine housekeeping measure that only fills committee seats and doesn't change any law or spending.
